analysis_scope: Read-only SQLite/content analysis; no tests, compilation, ROS, Gazebo or robot motions were run.
validation_limits: Checks cover database layout, indices, durations, integer pulses 0..1000 and hashes. They do not establish URDF compatibility, motion meaning, displacement, balance or grasp success.

local_storage.note: Inventory paths describe the original 98-file analysis; backups/recordings remain in the unchanged source archive. See CLEANUP_RU.md.
